title: Online Prediction System for Proactive Autoscaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.33332v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present an online learning system for short-term time series forecasting that enables proactive autoscaling in large-scale distributed systems. Unlike traditional forecasting methods that focus on modeling seasonality and long-term trends, the system targets high-accuracy, low-latency predictions for immediate future intervals for dynamic resource management in internet-scale infrastructures. The system employs a two-stage architecture: a seasonality decomposition stage followed by a residual correction stage using lightweight linear models with engineered features. By retraining models on-the-fly for every prediction cycle, the online prediction system continuously adapts to changing demand patterns without requiring persistent model storage or feature drift monitoring. translated_title: 用于主动式自动扩缩容的在线预测系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于短期时间序列预测的在线学习系统，可在大规模分布式系统中实现主动式自动扩缩容。与传统的注重建模季节性和长期趋势的预测方法不同，该系统针对即将到来的时间区间提供高精度、低延迟的预测，服务于互联网规模基础设施中的动态资源管理。该系统采用两阶段架构：首先进行季节性分解，随后使用带有工程特征的轻量级线性模型进行残差修正。通过在每次预测周期中即时重新训练模型，该在线预测系统能够持续适应不断变化的需求模式，而无需持久化模型存储或特征漂移监控。该系统已部署在众多异构服务中，每小时处理超过90万次预测；在生产流量的离线评估中，其基于STL的配置（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种两阶段在线预测系统，通过季节性分解结合轻量级线性模型的残差修正，并借助每个预测周期的即时重训练，为大规模分布式系统的主动式自动扩缩容提供高精度、低延迟的短期流量预测。
en_tdlr: An online prediction system combining seasonality decomposition with lightweight linear residual correction and on-the-fly retraining delivers high-accuracy, low-latency short-term forecasts to enable proactive autoscaling in internet-scale distributed systems.
